text:
I'm heading to Corvanta's session next Tuesday in Midtown: "Operationalizing AI-native revenue intelligence at enterprise scale."

The title is a mouthful, but the premise is something every GTM team I know wrestles with: knowing which deals will actually close this quarter and which are quietly slipping.

Corvanta's product reads a sales team's call recordings and CRM history to flag deals likely to slip in the current quarter. One of their customers, a 200-rep software company, says it cut its end-of-quarter forecast miss from 18% to 7%. I want to hear how that happened in practice.

Tomasz Arkwright-Bell, Corvanta's head of sales operations, is speaking, and I'm hoping he gets into the unglamorous parts:

→ How reps and managers responded when the tool flagged their deals
→ What changed in forecast calls and pipeline reviews
→ What it took to get the data clean enough to trust

If you run sales ops, RevOps, or forecasting, this looks worth the evening. I'll share what I learn.

Who else is going?
